items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: I know he went to a different name but Pujol. But his name was Palaszczuk.

ctx.x: Well, your earliest recollections though, they were already white people playing jazz.

I know he went to a different name but Pujol. But his name was Palaszczuk. You see what I mean? Yeah. But we gave him the name of Pujol. I don't know how to call him, but that was it. Now, that was the men that really played in the high roles. Now, you had the...
Which one was the leader, Tink? Did you remember him? Bill Gallaty. Bill Gallaty.
